rows.grounds: locative plural of the compound naming the three sides of the root site
compound of shaking and door in accusative singular
indeclinable adverbial form meaning as is fitting

items.question: How should the shaking door be arranged at the three sides of the root site?
items.inference: the shaking door is to be placed appropriately at the three sides of the root site
uncertainties: exact ritual function of the shaking door is not specified here
items.plain_english: At the three sides of the root site, the shaking door is to be placed as appropriate.
